observations: photo 0 shows a vintage-style sewing machine on a wooden cabinet/stand with a treadle base (manual/foot-powered look).
The machine head has a visible brand/logo that appears to read 'LION' (exact model not readable).
The seller text says 'Two lion machine with overlapping table', but only one machine/one cabinet is clearly shown in the provided photo.

identity.kind: treadle/manual sewing machine on wooden cabinet/stand

claims.claim: Two lion machine with overlapping table
claims.evidence: Only one sewing machine/cabinet is clearly visible in photo 0; no second machine or overlapping table is shown.

risks.risk: Whether it is truly two machines (seller claim) vs one machine; price depends heavily on quantity.
risks.proof: Ask for photo(s) showing both machine heads clearly from the front and a wide shot showing the full overlapping table/cabinet arrangement.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a single LION treadle/manual sewing machine (worst case vs 'two machines').

risks.risk: Condition/working status (treadle, belt/drive, needle bar, timing) cannot be confirmed from a single still photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: start the treadle, show needle moving, and demonstrate a few stitches on fabric.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case).

risks.risk: Missing parts/accessories (bobbin case, presser feet, needles, power/attachments if any) and cabinet damage.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of: bobbin area, presser foot(s), needle clamp, and underside/drive mechanism; plus a photo of any included accessories.

risks.risk: Exact type (manual vs electric) and model cannot be confirmed; comparables vary widely.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the label/plate with model number and a clear shot of the drive system (treadle vs motor).
risks.if_unproven: Price as manual/treadle only (based on photo 0).

proof_requests: Wide shot showing the full setup proving there are two LION machines and how they overlap on the table/cabinet.
Video of the machine in action: treadle movement + needle movement + a few stitches on fabric.
Close-ups of bobbin case/inside, presser foot(s), needle clamp, and the underside/drive mechanism.
Photo of the machine’s label/plate showing model number (and any serial/brand plate).
response.reason: The item type is visible (LION treadle/manual sewing machine), but the key pricing driver—whether there are two machines and whether it works—is not provable from the single photo.
